input_stack: [z-1 .. z+1] slices from <log>/img sorted by page index, clamped at the ends
prediction: per member: soft-argmax of the pith heatmap channel, normalized (x, y); ensemble: arithmetic mean of the members' points in native pixels (x * 778), as in scripts/eval_ensemble_pith_wood.py
rounding: rint of the mean point, clipped to [0, 777]; integer pixel index (Supervisely convention: column x, row y)
null_pages: none: the models always predict a point
